title: Cosmic Black Hole
description: A large circular formation dominates the center of the image, featuring concentric rings that transition from bright white-blue at the core to darker blue and black toward the outer edges. The surrounding dark space contains scattered specks of white and orange dots, with visible brushstroke textures and paint drips throughout.
